name: The Circle
description: Status and strategy collide in this social experiment and competition show where online players flirt, befriend and catfish their way toward $100,000.

videos.title: Hello, Circle
videos.overview: Ready for first impressions? The experiment begins as the players craft their profiles and start connecting ... for better or worse.

videos.title: Face-to-Face
videos.overview: A surprise confrontation raises the stakes of the game. Later, the players get ready to party, and a special guest scopes out the competition.

videos.title: There's a Catfish Among Us
videos.overview: An anonymous game of “Ask Me Anything” leads to a series of accusations. Meanwhile, Miranda refines her cheeky strategy, and Shubham finds his voice.

videos.title: Planting Doubt
videos.overview: Another tense elimination leads to an honest conversation, a casual connection evolves into an intimate bond, and a quirky new player joins the game.

videos.title: Sliding into DMs
videos.overview: As a new day dawns, a fresh face joins the Circle -- and presents a series of stirring questions. Rebecca turns the heat up on the gameplay.

videos.title: Anonymous Trolling
videos.overview: Mercedeze faces her toughest critics and makes a candid request. Two new influencers are picked, and one player must say goodbye.

videos.title: Picking Teams
videos.overview: Two new players settle into the Circle, just in time for trivia night. On the heels of a competitive match, Sammie makes an emotional reveal.

videos.title: The Player I'm Saving Is ...
videos.overview: Tension and tenderness intersect as the influencers deal with an elimination twist, and two players connect in person. A new face joins the fun.

videos.title: Instant Block
videos.overview: How about another round of shake-ups? Sean shares a personal secret with the Circle, and a face-to-face meeting makes for an unusual bond.

videos.title: Declare Your Rival
videos.overview: The Circle dials up the drama with a cutthroat round of true confessions. The game’s first “superinfluencer” steps into power.

videos.title: The Last Rating
videos.overview: As the experiment winds down, Sammie and Ed bond over similar suspicions. The players prepare to choose a winner -- and orchestrate one last block.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: The truth finally comes to light when the finalists meet in the flesh, and at the players reunion, the winner is announced.

videos.title: Back and More Savage Than Ever
videos.overview: The game begins as eight players — including a familiar face from “Too Hot to Handle” — move in, make profiles and (warily) mingle.

videos.title: Alliances Are Formed
videos.overview: As the influencers consider their pivotal picks, the others continue building relationships. Also, creativity and cringe collide during a poetry slam.

videos.title: Bye, Bye, Bye!
videos.overview: A new player sparks excitement and uncertainty. Savannah spills the tea — and targets a former ally. A game of Truth or Dare takes a tense turn.

videos.title: Lines Are Drawn
videos.overview: Bad blood continues to boil between Terilisha and Savannah, leaving the other players torn about their loyalties. Chloe questions Emily’s game play.

videos.title: Snake in the Grass
videos.overview: As Courtney takes control of an intriguing twist, the others reconvene and unpack some elimination drama. Meanwhile, two new players join the game.

videos.title: A Love Triangle
videos.overview: A new day dawns as Chloe considers her feelings for Trevor — and Mitchell. The Joker shakes up the ranking. Terilisha and Khat explore a new theory.

videos.title: Friend Zoned....
videos.overview: A blocked player pays a visit and plants new seeds of skepticism. Khat puts Lance’s identity to the test. Jonathan Van Ness pops in for a challenge.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: Tensions mount as catfish accusations fly. Meanwhile, an anonymous round of Q&A stirs the pot, and a unique double block redefines the game.

videos.title: A New Twist
videos.overview: Khat takes aim at Chloe’s integrity — much to the dismay of her allies. Trevor pursues a better bond with Mitchell. A new player makes himself at home.

videos.title: Campaigning to Win
videos.overview: The sweet sound of patriotism sweeps through the Circle as the players take part in Democracy Day. An elimination deliberation gets personal.

videos.title: The Master Plan
videos.overview: After a major blocking, the players decode a departing message. Two competing duos craft new plans. The Circle goes glam for an awards ceremony.

videos.title: The Last Blocking
videos.overview: The players brace for a final blocking and attempt to build last-minute bonds. Chloe faces a hard truth. The Circle reveals a new influencer twist.

videos.title: And the Winner Is...
videos.overview: Host Michelle Buteau greets the finalists as they prepare for one last rating — and a face-to-face meetup. Who will take home the $100,000 prize?

videos.title: Circle, Did You Miss Me?
videos.overview: The game begins as the players make profiles and share their interests, including shirtless selfies, family bickering and a casual blocking.

videos.title: A New Twist
videos.overview: A shocking shake-up leaves the players divided — and more confused than ever. Meanwhile, one jokester initiates a group chat with like-minded friends.

videos.title: Identity Theft
videos.overview: After a pivotal vote, the group grapples with a wave of skepticism. Two new players join the Circle. A flashback photo game reveals new truths.

videos.title: A Flirtatious Alliance
videos.overview: A morning chat sparks fresh flirtation, the players throw shade during an anonymous review session, and the influencers receive a last-minute alert.

videos.title: The Real Michelle
videos.overview: After a face-to-face blocking, a competitor stirs the pot. The Wolf Pack grows as a new alliance takes shape. Lil Yachty stops by for a rap battle.

videos.title: A New Member of the Wolfpack
videos.overview: An enthusiastic newbie joins the game and catches up on lingering drama. Elsewhere, the group prepares for a rating that's chock-full of surprises.

videos.title: Shock Blocking
videos.overview: Tension leads to tenderness as a blocked player bids farewell, but not before gifting a secret advantage. A mysterious ghost hunter joins the game.

videos.title: Full Out War
videos.overview: Things take a sweet — and strategic — turn as the players decorate cakes. Later, one ally tests another's loyalty, and two new influencers take control.

videos.title: Ghostbusting & Catfishing
videos.overview: A double-blocking bombshell leaves the players speechless. A sudden alert sheds new light on a secret reality, and an avid gamer gets ready to play.

videos.title: A Circle Divided
videos.overview: A player speaks the truth — and puts a target on another’s back. An alert triggers a sigh of relief, and a group chat showdown gets personal.

videos.title: Choosing Sides
videos.overview: After a bit of back and forth, the influencers agree on a block. A departing player spills some tea. Plus, the Circle goes glam for prom night!

videos.title: The Final Stretch
videos.overview: The final blocking draws closer, but not before a suite of emotional messages arrive. Also, the players start to sweat during a savage round of Q&A.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: Michelle Buteau delivers surprise and delight as the final five reflect on their gameplay and get ready for the grand reveal of this season’s winner.

videos.title: A Spicy Start
videos.overview: The players move in and virtually mingle, chatting about everything from beloved pups to pimple popping. But who will make the best first impression?

videos.title: Cake Me As I Am
videos.overview: On the heels of a spicy twist, a new competitor makes his way into the game, the crew gets crafty with a cake challenge, and alliances take shape.

videos.title: 90's Party Surprise
videos.overview: A player bids farewell and shares parting advice. Two newbies join the game — armed with friendly banter and witch oil. Also, it's '90s party time!

videos.title: Nobody Is Safe
videos.overview: The gang needs answers as two pop stars work to keep up their ruse. Will they score points or spark suspicions during the trivia challenge?

videos.title: Goodbye My Friends
videos.overview: A mission comes to a close-but was it a success? After saying goodbye to the pop icons, the group continues the search for catfish.

videos.title: All Is Fair in Circle  War
videos.overview: As alliances evolve, one player perfects his bro-cabulary. Meanwhile, ratings are revealed, and comedian Nikki Glaser leads a roast-writing challenge.

videos.title: The Party Divide
videos.overview: Power takes a painful turn, and an influencer deals with an in-person blocking. Two newcomers join the game including one with a familiar face.

videos.title: Circle Cyber Attack
videos.overview: After the parties, the players return to bonding and scheming, until a mysterious and menacing glitch triggers more drama than ever before.

videos.title: Trust Is Tested
videos.overview: A surprising exit challenges an alliance. A fitness frenzy gets the gang moving, and two contestants turn up the heat in an extra sexy private chat.

videos.title: A Plea for Survival
videos.overview: Two players bond over an emotional share, a ratings reveal leaves the group speechless, and the influencers make major moves in front of everybody.

videos.title: Throw to the Wolves
videos.overview: Who will stay after two powerful pleas? It's time to find out. The competitors pick up the brushes - and turn ruthless - during a painting session.

videos.title: Just When You Thought You Were Safe
videos.overview: Suspicions mount over one player's identity. The Circle delivers some surprise tenderness. A secret super influencer selects this season's finalists.

videos.title: A Winner Is Crowned
videos.overview: Michelle Buteau reunites this season's players as the game comes to a close - and a winner is named. Who will take home the whopping cash prize?

videos.title: Single and Ready to Mingle
videos.overview: Eight players kick things off by discussing go-to dance moves, past relationships and more. First impressions form fast, so every emoji counts.

videos.title: An Unlikely Team Emerges
videos.overview: After a shocking vote, two players get a big surprise. A funny new face has the chat laughing, while strategic cliques start to form behind the scenes.

videos.title: I Can't Believe I Just Sent That…
videos.overview: One player opens up in a game of Truth Or Dare while another sets off catfish alarm bells. Two potential couples get their Circle flirt on.

videos.title: Who to Save?
videos.overview: After a dating profile game results in some bruised egos, the influencers debate a tough decision when the time comes to block someone.

videos.title: Hi Old Friend
videos.overview: A familiar face returns to The Circle with a brand-new online personality. The competition heats up when two players compete to recruit followers.

videos.title: A Desperate Alliance
videos.overview: Everyone models their best assets during a sculpting challenge to win a date. One player weighs loyalty versus strategy while considering who to block.

videos.title: Glam Party Twist
videos.overview: The players go head-to-head in a trivia showdown, explore possible alliances during a virtual mixer and welcome a fabulous competitor to the chat.

videos.title: An F-Boy Is Exposed
videos.overview: Will one person's seductive strategy backfire? The claws come out for anonymous Savage Questions, just in time for a game-changing round of ratings.

videos.title: Return of the Inner Circle
videos.overview: The DMs heat up as players trade advice and apologies, and a Hacker impersonates an unsuspecting competitor. Wild rhymes fly at an animal-themed party.

videos.title: The Hunt for the Hacker
videos.overview: One person plays cupid for a smitten contestant. With the Hacker's chat wreaking havoc and a new block about to drop, nobody in The Circle feels safe.

videos.title: Circle Power Couple
videos.overview: As The Circle starts to shrink, suspicions grow. Tan France challenges the group to style a mannequin look that stands out.

videos.title: A Brutal Blocking
videos.overview: With two days left, all the players are feeling the love. But when a big move leads to a shocking Blocking, who will have to leave the party early?

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: A secret Superinfluencer blocks one last player before the final five put their cards on the table and Michelle Buteau crowns the season's winner.

videos.title: New City Who Dis?
videos.overview: First impressions are everything in Atlanta as players join The Circle, fire up the chat and find allies. But suspicions swirl when ratings are revealed.

videos.title: Bro Code
videos.overview: With two new players in the group, one takes catfishing to another level. Bold personalities show initiative and form alliances to improve their ratings.

videos.title: I'm Only Human…or Am I?
videos.overview: Mistrust breeds as the players absorb a recent revelation. After the group cracks jokes, a critical thinking test raises more questions than answers.

videos.title: Spot the Bot
videos.overview: The presence of an AI bot puts the players on high alert as they share personal photos, open up private chats and plant seeds of doubt among the group.

videos.title: Portrait Pitfalls
videos.overview: The fallout from an influencer's decision to send someone home brings relief for some and shade to others. The group stirs up drama with an art project.

videos.title: That DM Slide
videos.overview: Two new players shake up The Circle and one contestant races to spill the tea. After another round of ratings, two influencers must make a tough decision.

videos.title: Ride or Die
videos.overview: A blocked player shares fiery parting words and puts old allies on blast. A revealing compatibility game matches each influencer with their ride-or-die.

videos.title: Who Ordered the Sacrificial Lamb?
videos.overview: With the rules of the game turned upside down, the players need to rethink their strategies — fast. A pair with low ratings weighs their options.

videos.title: Naughty or Nice
videos.overview: After a shocking discovery, everyone participates in a spicy game involving their nicest and naughtiest photos. Two players strengthen their connection.

videos.title: A Deadly Deadlock
videos.overview: Things get personal when players answer anonymously submitted questions. Tensions erupt between two influencers with very different strategies.

videos.title: It's Giving Sus
videos.overview: The Circle is more divided than ever after another influencer gets blocked. No longer in pairs, each player sends a gift to a BFF of their choice.

videos.title: A Final Power Move
videos.overview: Friendships are tested as betrayals emerge. Messages from home bring all the feels. A secret Superinfluencer — plus new blocking — rattles the group.

videos.title: Finale
videos.overview: The Circle is even smaller as the remaining players lock in their final ratings and have one last chat — in person. Who will take home the grand prize?

videos.title: The Disruption Begins
videos.overview: From perfect profile pics to snappy hashtags, players aim to make dazzling first impressions in the chat. But will a dicey quiz reveal their true colors?

videos.title: It's MY Party…
videos.overview: A twisty blocking shocks everyone, and two new faces enter the chat. The invite list for a VIP party ignites tension and creates new rivalries.

videos.title: Battle of the Influencers
videos.overview: One player does damage control as a new couple forms. A pop culture quiz sparks suspicions of deception, and the influencers clash over a tense blocking.

videos.title: Press to Impress
videos.overview: A departing player's final message rattles the chat and exposes hidden alliances. Some players bond over family ties as others forge new allies.

videos.title: Circle Wedding Crashers
videos.overview: A secret profile swap leads to a steamy private chat, and a messy game forces the players to reveal who they'd wed, smooch - or take down.

videos.title: Reading Between the Lines
videos.overview: After a bold newbie crashes the group's wedding party, an anonymous tarot card game shows the player's hands - and some get the reading of a lifetime.

videos.title: Dawn of the Circle Dead
videos.overview: A scheming player shakes up the chat with a strategic strike against a power alliance. Later, a zombie pep rally lifts spirits.

videos.title: Gloating Around
videos.overview: One player scores a major edge from a game-changing twist. Then, a drawing challenge leaves me feeling sketched out before an intense blocking.

videos.title: Help! I'm Drowning
videos.overview: After an explosive blocking, two players try to unmask a scheme in the chat. An anonymous Q&A exposes a lie and stirs speculation about a catfish.

videos.title: A Circle Trilogy
videos.overview: As new alliances emerge, two players deepen their connection. With ratings looming, a spirited game uncovers what the group can't live without.

videos.title: Incoming Call
videos.overview: Things get heated in the chat after an emotional blocking. A player begins a campaign to take down an ex-ally. Messages from home motivate the group.

videos.title: It's Giving Season
videos.overview: Players rush to secure alliances before the final ratings. An awards game offers one last chance to throw shade. The secret super influencer is named.

videos.title: The Grand Finale
videos.overview: After the final blocked player exits, the group meets face-to-face for the first time as the competition wraps up. Who will claim the $100,000 prize?
